headline: Sattva plots in North Bengaluru, beside the outer ring road.
pitch: Sattva Thippapura is a gated plotted development of more than 24 acres. You choose your plot and build your own home, with a known builder's layout and approvals behind it.

reasons.title: Land you own outright
reasons.text: A plot gives you the land itself, in a gated layout by a known builder, and the freedom to build when you choose.
reasons.source: Project material, as listed by 100 Yards

reasons.title: Jobs are moving north
reasons.text: The KIADB Aerospace Park covers nearly 950 acres of aerospace manufacturing and testing next to the airport.

reasons.title: On the outer ring road
reasons.text: The site is listed about 300 m from the Satellite Town Ring Road, with Doddaballapura station about 3 km away.

reasons.title: A new ring road is planned
reasons.text: The Bengaluru Business Corridor (Peripheral Ring Road) is a 73 km road with a reported 2029 deadline, linking the Devanahalli side with the Sarjapur side.

upcoming.status: Trial runs began November 2026. 38.44 km from KR Puram to the airport via Hebbal and Yelahanka. Overall construction was 72% in August 2026; completion is reported for December 2027.
upcoming.why: A metro within reach turns a car-only address into a commuter address.
upcoming.source: IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Business Today, 6 Aug 2026; Oneindia, 2026

upcoming.status: Operating, nearly 950 acres beside the airport.
upcoming.why: New factories and offices bring tenants and buyers who want to live close by.

upcoming.status: Kempegowda International Airport keeps adding capacity, with an Airport City business district around it.
upcoming.why: Market reports name airport expansion as the main engine of housing demand in North Bengaluru.

upcoming.status: 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens cross-city trips.

timelineSource: Business Today, 6 Aug 2026; IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Oneindia, 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: Plots here are a long-term holding. The airport and the industrial belt are the reasons buyers are looking this far north.

up: The airport metro opening on schedule
The Aerospace Park and Airport City adding jobs
Few large branded projects close to the airport
down: Delays to the metro or ring road
Many projects launching in Devanahalli together
Long drive to the city centre until the metro runs
